title: CreateNode payload
description: Typed payload for the create-node operation kind (registry code 1). Create a new node entity; facts (property intervals) are added by separate operations. Fields are grounded in crates/mneme_core/src/ops.rs::CreateNodeInput, rendered in canonical contract names. Record-level access control (owner/acl/visibility) is intentionally omitted at M0: M0 has one principal with full authority and no record-level RBAC; policy is owned by Themis (M6) and will arrive as explicit versioned policy operations, not creation-record fields (ADR-0030). Encoded per the canonical-JSON profile: all fields present, absent optionals as null, UUIDs lower-case hyphenated, HLC as a decimal string.

node_id.description: Per-instance entity identifier, minted once at creation.

type_id.description: Metamodel symbol UUID (UUIDv5) of the entity type, e.g. Application.

hlc.description: Full-range HLC coordinate as a decimal string (canonical-JSON profile).
